Our doctors

Doctors Who Care for Children and the Whole Family

Meet our family physicians, whose experience spans paediatric-focused care, everyday health concerns, chronic conditions and preventive healthcare across every stage of life.

Family Physician · Child & Adolescent Health

Dr Amanda Toh

MBBS, GDFM, GDCAH

Dr Amanda Toh is a dedicated family physician with extensive experience in primary care, including her time at SingHealth Polyclinics. She holds a Graduate Diploma in Family Medicine (GDFM) and a Graduate Diploma in Child and Adolescent Health (GDCAH), reflecting her strong interest in paediatrics and commitment to caring for patients of all ages.

With a particular passion for children's health, Dr Amanda is experienced in caring for infants, young children and adolescents, alongside managing a wide range of acute and chronic medical conditions. She believes in providing gentle, attentive care to her young patients while offering reassurance and guidance to parents.

Known for her warm and approachable manner, Dr Amanda values building meaningful relationships with her patients through attentive listening and clear communication. She places strong emphasis on preventive healthcare and strives to provide compassionate, practical and patient-centred care for the whole family.

Family Physician · Paediatrics & Family Health

Dr Kwok Xin Hao

MBBS, GDFM

Dr Kwok Xin Hao is a dedicated family physician with a broad range of clinical experience, having previously worked in both hospital emergency departments and polyclinics. He holds a Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) and a Graduate Diploma in Family Medicine (GDFM), equipping him with a strong foundation in managing a wide variety of medical conditions across all age groups.

With a keen interest in paediatrics and family health, Dr Kwok enjoys caring for infants, young children and adolescents, alongside managing acute illnesses and chronic medical conditions. His experience in both emergency and primary care settings allows him to approach his patients' healthcare needs with a well-rounded and holistic perspective.

Dr Kwok believes in providing compassionate, patient-centred care and strives to create a warm and reassuring environment where children feel comfortable and parents feel at ease. He values building lasting relationships with his patients through attentive listening, clear communication and a strong emphasis on preventive healthcare, supporting individuals and families through every stage of life.
